text:
james_sales: Urgent escalatation for Aurora POC — demo tomorrow blocked by auth failures and customer saying our discount math is wrong. Need exec bridge today.
elaine_solutioneng: What's the exact auth failure? can you paste the response?
james_sales: They hit our hosted /v1/chat and get 403 with this body:
```
403 Forbidden
{"error":"token_rejected", "reason": "missing_subject"}
```
They say their IdP is sending a custom `employee_id` claim instead of `email`.
rachel_security: Sounds like claim mapping mismatch. Our token-introspector currently expects `sub` or `email`. We could add `employee_id` as allowed claim, but that's an infra change. @omar_platform any quick path?
omar_platform: We can add a tolerant claim mapping flag to the introspector and roll it in a small patch. Dev->canary in ~30m, full prod in ~1h if no blockers. Minor restart required.
james_sales: Customer absolutely needs SSO working for CTO demo. They refuse service-account fallback.
opsbot: [system] label set: deal/blocked/auth — raised by james_sales at 1820012360 :warning:
elaine_solutioneng: On pricing, they claim committed discount of 35%; sales quoting sheet shows 20%. Is this a miscommunication?
tyler_finance: 35% on a $500k ARR commitment requires VP approval. We can pre-approve for demo contingent on signed LOI. Need a short note from sales on ARR, term, and product mix.
james_sales: I'll get the ARR/term numbers. They told us 12 months reserved capacity + hosted API — approx $500k first year.
rachel_security: Re auth: if we flip mapping live it's low risk but audit wants a post-change review. I'll need to see logs snapshot and run a quick security checklist (no PII leaks, mapping deterministic).
omar_platform: Agreed. I can do the change and enable a feature-flag gate so we can revert quickly. Plan: merge patch, deploy to canary at 1820012620, smoke tests, then prod at 1820012800. ETA for full prod verification 15m after deploy.
elaine_solutioneng: Can we schedule an exec bridge at 14:30 PT? Need product + eng + finance + legal. CTO prefers morning but said 14:30 ok.
tyler_finance: I can do 14:30 if we get the ARR confirmation and the discount ask in writing before the call.
james_sales: Sending email to Aurora now with numbers and their requested 35% ask. Also invited their CTO to 14:30 bridge.
opsbot: [system] calendar invite created: exec-bridge/aurora-14_30-PT by james_sales at 1820012450 :calendar:
omar_platform: Canary deploy started at 1820012620. I'll stream logs to the bridge channel.
rachel_security: Watching canary. First 50 requests show 100% acceptance of `employee_id` mapping. No unexpected attributes.
omar_platform: Canary good. Promoting to prod at 1820012800. Rolling restart of token-introspector.
opsbot: [system] deploy status: prod rollout started at 1820012800 — owner: omar_platform
omar_platform: Prod patch live at 1820012835. Restart took ~90s. No errors in initial 500 requests.
rachel_security: Post-deploy checks complete at 1820012860. Logs look clean, mapping works as expected. Rotating short-lived keys for the broker now.
james_sales: Aurora confirmed demo passed with CTO — they were able to SSO. Great job.
elaine_solutioneng: Back to pricing: Aurora sent a screenshot of a conversation indicating 35% was discussed in an internal thread. Can't be treated as contract. We can offer a one-time promotional 30% for the first 3 months as a bridge while legal drafts an amendment.
tyler_finance: 30% pre-approved for initial term pending LOI/signed amendment. 35% requires exec approval and revenue ops sign-off.
james_sales: CTO pressing for the higher number live on the call. Can we get a short-term committed discount at 30% to close the pilot? We'll follow up with contract amendment for 35% if execs approve.
elaine_solutioneng: I support 30% temporary for demo closure. But we need cadence: 30% for first 90 days, then revert to 20% unless amendment executed. Nadia_legal: (not in channel) I'll sync with legal — we need an LOI or email confirmation and then we can fast-track a signed amendment.
opsbot: [system] label updated: deal/escalation/exec-bridge by opsbot at 1820012890
omar_platform: Closing loop on infra: feature-flag is on and will be auto-rolled back in 7 days unless prod approved. I'll keep monitoring.
rachel_security: Security sign-off pending docs attached to the amendment: audit trail of claim mapping change and key rotation. I'll upload logs to secure review.
james_sales: Action items before the bridge: 1) James — confirm ARR and email Aurora ask (done). 2) Omar — keep monitoring rollout. 3) Rachel — upload security notes. 4) Tyler — prepare finance blurb re: 30% temporary approval. 5) Elaine — prep product talking points on pilot scope.
opsbot: [system] action items created and assigned at 1820012940
elaine_solutioneng: Thanks all. I'll run the bridge and handle the client-facing pricing language.
tyler_finance: I'll be on the call. If exec wants 35% live we'll need a post-call executive approval workflow.
james_sales: Bridge done at 14:30 PT. CTO verbal OK to pilot at 30% with LOI email. They requested written amendment for any higher discount. Closing notes: proceed with onboarding and attach amendment workflow to the deal.
opsbot: [system] deal status: blocked -> in-progress at 1820013040 by james_sales
elaine_solutioneng: Follow-up thread will track contract signature and billing start. I'll spin that up and invite both legal and finance.
